lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgMn2(CoO3)2 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a 20-atom unit cell and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Co and Mg centers, each with six oxygen neighbors, while Mn adopts six-coordinate oxygen environments. Corner-sharing is observed between Co and Mg octahedra, as well as between Co octahedra, with an additional edge-sharing relation between Co octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
